[[File:Beyond Season 1 & 2.png|thumb|Pokémon Season 1 & 2 - Limited Edition Collection]] The '''Pokémon Season 1 & 2 - Limited Edition Collection''' is a Region 4 DVD set released by {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} in Australia on November 19, 2014. This DVD set is also referred to as the '''Pokémon Season 1 & 2 Gift Set''' in promotional material. It contains four individual half-season DVD cases with three discs. The individual half-season DVD cases were never sold individually. Overall, the set includes 12 discs with 101 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE5661. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning. This DVD set was rereleased in a more slim design as the '''Pokémon The Series: The Beginning The Collection''' by [https://shock.com.au Shock Entertainment] in Australia on December 2, 2020 with the catalogue number KAL5524. It contains all episodes of {{aniseries|PTS}} from [[S01|Indigo League]] and [[S02|Adventures in the Orange Islands]], with the exceptions of ''[[Holiday Hi-Jynx]]'', ''[[EP090|Stage Fight!]]'', and ''[[EP099|The Mandarin Island Miss Match]]'' (all of which featured {{p|Jynx}} in its original design).
